visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 current portable frames including the compact summary: broad gold bulb dome on a blue drum, paired cylindrical gold minarets with single balconies and rounded upper caps, flat pale marble portico roofs on columns, tall blue-bordered pointed iwan with nested gold arch facets and three wood doors, and recessed arched side/rear windows. Fine tile and calligraphic art, exact muqarnas, temporary lights, flags, scaffolding and unseen interiors remain omitted. The two inspected photographs show construction work; the model represents a simplified finished core rather than its precise construction phase.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final shared/geographic-flat views, including the north-up placement overlay. Six shared 256² sandstone, marble, cast-bronze, mosaic, lime-plaster and wood graphs serve seven merged roles including opaque blue-grey glazing. Metric UVs and linear tints; no embedded images or unique facade atlas. Each graph is read once and eviction leaves zero live model geometries. The main outline and heading remain fixed, with the mapped dome/minaret centers retained. Flat placement captures verify transforms and replacement, not local terrain accuracy.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 27 final medium-fi frames: Economy and High, noon and late light, three distances, untextured silhouette, six details, four matched LODs and four transitions. Also inspected the matched skyline at full size. Skyline 580 retains the bulb dome, paired single-balcony minarets and open marble portico; district 1745 adds doors/window rhythm and blue/gold borders, street 5358 adds wall recesses and details, closeup 8564 refines curves and balcony posts. Initial skyline plus district is 215972 bytes plus shared textures, one/seven draws. Corrected the skyline balcony floor height before final captures. Switches add glazing, trim, rounded profiles and rails visibly; the synthetic Mediterranean neighbors and coarse terrain are fixtures. Some grazing roof shadow striping remains a renderer artifact in the shared rig. Physical laptop/phone measurements remain pending.

No surveyed height or precise construction-phase claim. The unresolved dome map-height conflict remains visible in source and this review. Roof and portico partitions, door and window rhythm, small relief, finish and unseen rear details are estimates. No bespoke survey sources, redistributed photographs, copied tile art or furnished interior.
